title: Embed this comparison
intro: Free for blogs, forums and websites. Keep the link to Specvane — that is the only condition.
pageTitle: Free comparison widgets for blogs and forums
pageLead: Add a live spec comparison or a product spec card to your article, review or forum post. Always up to date, works in 20 languages, free.
steps: Open any model or comparison page on Specvane.
Press «Embed on your site» and choose the format: HTML for websites, image for forums, BBCode or Markdown.
Copy the code and paste it into your post. The widget updates itself when specifications change.
rules: Free for personal and commercial websites, blogs and forums.
Keep the visible link to Specvane under the widget.
Do not change the data inside the widget or present it as your own measurements.
Specifications come from manufacturers and may contain errors — see our legal notice.
formatsText: Interactive table (iframe) for websites; picture with a link for forums where iframes are not allowed; ready BBCode and Markdown.
